name: webapp-security-hardening
description: Phased web app security audit, hardening, and crawl-boundary program (skill).

scripts.test: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do echo "→ $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: for f in scripts/*.mjs scripts/lib/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in scripts/*.sh test/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'lint ok'
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && bash test/shell-smoke.sh
